title: Luminar Technologies

Solid-State LiDAR Confident 2025
Compact, low-cost LiDAR without spinning parts: Luminar Iris, Innoviz One
📈 Luminar Iris is the solid-state LiDAR product targeting automotive OEM integration. Volvo, Mercedes, and Airbus are customers. Transition from spinning to solid-state is the structural catalyst.
